# Local citation audit

This file records locators checked against the retained PDFs on 2026-10-06.
It supplies research input for the central citations audit.
It does not change the central semantics register or any proof status.

The paper metadata comes from each title page and publication footer.
The Huet publication date also uses the publisher record linked in the reading guide.
The file hashes and source URLs are in [manifest.json](manifest.json).
